(The equipment, the owner's money and the list of accounts on the same page are in the next entry.)

get_there: Menu → Accountant → Chart of Accounts (for the owner, a general manager, a branch manager and purchasing it is folded under More). Also: the year-end and period links on Reports; an alert 'Reconcile the bank…' leads to the bank page under it.
before: Months (periods) are made by the database as entries are posted into them; a month with no posting yet has no period and no closing panel.
To lock a month: every trading day's cash counted (End of Day), no stock count waiting, no draft journals, every earlier month locked, and each subledger agreeing with its account.

parts.shows: The title 'Chart of Accounts', the line 'Trial balance & closing the period', a badge 'Period debits equal credits' (green) or 'Period debits do not equal credits' (red) from the totals below, and the chosen month's name with its state, e.g. '2026-09 open' or '2026-08 locked' (red when locked).

parts.name: Trial Balance
parts.shows: Heading 'Trial Balance' with '{from} to {to} · published entries only · IQD'. One row per account that has an opening, a movement or a closing balance: A/C (code), Account (name in the reader's language), Class (Asset, Liability, Equity, Income, Expense), Opening, Debit, Credit, Closing. Opening and Closing are debit-positive; a credit balance shows in brackets, e.g. (250,000). Drafts are left out. The last row, 'Totals for the period', adds the Debit and Credit columns. A note under it explains that the database guarantees debits equal credits for every published entry, and that whether the books are right is shown by the reconciliation on Reports.

parts.name: Close {period}
parts.shows: Only for the owner, a general manager, the accountant, a branch manager and the auditor (those with accounting.period.lock, accounting.post or audit.view), and only when a month is chosen. While open: the note 'Every check must pass before the period can be locked' and a table of checks, each with a mark — 'All good' (green), 'Stops the close' (red) or 'Warning' (orange) — the check and, when it fails, why. The checks, in order: 'Earlier periods are locked' ({n} earlier period(s) still open); 'No draft journals' ({n} draft journal(s) must be published or discarded); 'Every trading day's cash is counted' (Not counted: {days}); 'No stock count awaiting approval' ({n} count(s) submitted and not yet approved or rejected); each subledger against its account at the month's last day — 'Stock ledger agrees with Inventory (1200)', 'Unpaid bills agree with Accounts payable (2000)', 'Unbilled receipts agree with GRNI (2050)', 'Sales agree with net revenue (4000 less 4100 and 4200)', 'Card takings not yet settled agree with Card clearing (1010)', 'Orders the platforms owe agree with their receivable (1100)', 'What the drawers should hold agrees with Cash in the till (1000)', 'Cash moved through the safe agrees with the Safe (1005)', 'Dollars held, at what they were taken at, vs Cash in dollars (1001 and 1006)', 'Salaries owed agree with Salaries payable (2100)', 'Advances not yet taken back agree with Employee advances (1300)', 'Stock on its way agrees with Stock in transit (1210)', 'Prepaid expenses still to come vs Prepaid expenses (1400)', 'Every record has its one journal' (each failing one says e.g. 'stock ledger {a}, account 1200 {b}, difference {c}', or '{n} record(s) to look into: see Reports, Do the books tie?'); 'The period's journals balance' (out by {n}); 'Each prepaid expense's share of the month is posted' ({n} share(s) of prepaid expenses to {date}, {amount} IQD in all, are not posted: release them on Expenses). Warnings that do not stop the lock: 'No sale costed at nothing' ({n} sale(s) costed at nothing or in part at nothing: see Reports, Uncosted sales. Their profit is overstated. The month can still be locked); 'The month's payroll is approved' (The payroll for {YYYY-MM} is not approved: after the lock it cannot be posted into this month); 'The bank is reconciled to the month's end' ({n} bank line(s) to {date}, the first from {date}, are on no bank statement). Once locked, the checks are hidden and the header says 'Locked {when} by {name}'.

controls.label: Lock {period}
controls.does: The database runs every check again; if any blocking check fails it refuses. If all pass, the month is locked. If the month ends on 31 December, the year-end close is posted first: every income and cost account of the year is closed into 3100 Retained earnings as one journal ('Year-end close {year}'). The button shows 'Locking…' while it works.
controls.rules: Disabled while any blocking check fails; then 'Resolve the {n} failing check(s) first.' is shown beside it.
controls.after: No journal can be posted, changed or discarded with a date in that month any more; corrections go into an open month by reversing entries. The lock (who, when, the note) is on the audit trail as 'Period locked'. A December lock adds the year-end journal to the books.

controls.rules: Disabled until a reason is typed. Only the most recent locked month can be reopened.
controls.after: Postings into that month are allowed again. 'Period reopened' with the reason goes on the audit trail. A year-end journal already posted stays; it is not undone.

what_if.case: A check says 'Every trading day's cash is counted' fails with 'Not counted: 2026-09-14'
what_if.do: Count that day's drawer on End of Day (or close the drawer on the till), then come back and reload.

what_if.case: A mistake is found in a locked month
what_if.do: Do not reopen for small things: reverse or correct it in the current open month (Journals → Reverse, dated today). Only the owner reopens, with a reason, and only the latest locked month.

what_if.case: The payroll check warns
what_if.do: Approve the month's payroll on Payroll before locking, or it can never be posted into that month.

what_if.case: The bank check warns
what_if.do: Keep the bank's statement for that month on /accounting/bank first; the lock is still allowed.

parts.name: Equipment
parts.shows: Shown to those who see profit (owner, general manager, branch manager, accountant, auditor). Heading 'Equipment' and 'Worth in the books: {amount}'. A table: Equipment (name, and 'Bought {date} · {months} months' or 'Gone on {date}'), Cost, A month (its monthly depreciation), Depreciated (so far), Worth now ('—' when gone). Gone pieces are greyed. When months have passed without depreciation: 'Depreciation waits for {n} months gone.' with a button.

controls.label: Post it
controls.does: Posts the depreciation for every month gone that is not posted yet (never the current month): one journal per month, dated its last day, 'Depreciation YYYY-MM'.
controls.after: Books: Dr 6400 Depreciation, Cr 1590 Accumulated depreciation, for each month. The P&L of each month carries its share; 'Worth now' drops. Audit trail: 'Depreciation posted'. A month is posted only once, whoever presses.

controls.label: ＋ Add equipment
controls.does: Opens the form to add a piece.

controls.label: What is it?
controls.does: Its name (oven, gelato machine…).
controls.rules: Required, up to 80 letters.

controls.label: What it cost
controls.does: The price paid.
controls.rules: Required, more than 0.

controls.label: Months it will be used
controls.does: Its life in months.
controls.rules: 1 to 600; default 60.

controls.label: Worth at the end (0 if nothing)
controls.does: What it will still be worth at the end.
controls.rules: 0 or more and less than the cost; default 0.

controls.label: Bought on
controls.does: The day it was bought; depreciation starts that month.
controls.rules: Up to today; default today.

controls.label: How was it paid?
controls.does: Where the money came from: 'From the bank', 'From the safe', 'With the owner's own money', 'On a supplier's bill', 'Bought before: in the books already', or 'With the loan {code name}' for each loan account (2400–2499).
controls.rules: Default 'From the bank'.

controls.label: {amount} a month for {months} months
controls.does: A preview of the monthly depreciation: (cost − worth at the end) ÷ months, rounded.

controls.label: Add it
controls.does: Adds the piece.
controls.rules: Disabled until it has a name and a cost above 0.
controls.after: Books (unless 'Bought before'): Dr 1500 Equipment, Cr the account paid from — 1020 Bank, 1005 Safe, 3000 Owner equity, 2000 Accounts payable, or the loan — dated the day bought ('Equipment bought: {name}'). Paid from the safe lowers what the safe holds in the books. Audit trail: 'Equipment added'.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.does: Closes the form without saving.

controls.label: Sold or thrown out
controls.does: Opens the small form below the table for that piece.
controls.who: Owner, general manager, accountant; only for a piece not gone.

controls.label: When
controls.does: The day it went.
controls.rules: From the day it was bought up to today; default today.

controls.label: What it fetched (0 when thrown out)
controls.does: The money received for it.
controls.rules: 0 or more.

controls.label: The bank / The safe
controls.does: Where the money went; shown only when it fetched more than 0.
controls.rules: Default 'The bank'.

controls.label: Save
controls.does: Records the piece as gone.
controls.after: Books ('Equipment gone: {name}'): Cr 1500 its cost, Dr 1590 the depreciation so far, Dr 1020 Bank or 1005 Safe what it fetched, and the rest Dr 6900 Other expenses (a loss) or Cr 6900 (a gain). It takes no more depreciation from that month. Audit trail: 'Equipment sold or thrown out'.

parts.name: The owner's money
parts.shows: Shown to the owner, a general manager, a branch manager and the accountant. 'Put in' (all credits to 3000 Owner equity) and 'Taken out' (all debits to 3000 and 3200 Owner drawings), all time.

controls.label: The owner puts money in / The owner takes money out
controls.does: Which way the money goes.
controls.rules: Default: puts money in.

controls.label: The bank / The safe
controls.does: Where the money goes into or comes out of.
controls.rules: Default: the bank.

controls.label: Amount
controls.does: How much.
controls.rules: More than 0; commas allowed.

controls.label: What it is for (required)
controls.does: What the money is for; kept with the journal and the audit trail.
controls.rules: Required, up to 200 letters.

controls.label: Record it
controls.does: Records the movement of cash.
controls.rules: Disabled until there is an amount and a note.
controls.who: Putting in: anyone shown the card. Taking out: the owner only.
controls.after: Put in: Dr 1020 Bank or 1005 Safe, Cr 3000 Owner equity. Taken out: Dr 3200 Owner drawings, Cr 1020 Bank or 1005 Safe ('Cash from the … to the …: {note}'). The bank or safe balance in the books changes; 'Put in'/'Taken out' update; the move is on Sales' cash moves and the audit trail as 'Cash moved'. Taking out of the safe is refused if the safe does not hold that much in the books.

parts.shows: '{n} line(s) read · {from} to {to} · columns: {columns} · {n} row(s) left out: titles, totals and balances brought forward'; any lines that could not be read (in red, up to 8, then '…and {n} more'); '{n} of its line(s), to {date}, are on the statements kept already, and are left out.'; or 'Every line on it is on or before {date}, on the statements kept already.'; '{found} of its {n} line(s) are in the books, and are ticked.' Matching: same amount, the same day first, else the nearest day up to 31 days before or 7 days after; each books line used once. The statement's last day and balance (if it gives balances) are filled into the boxes below.

controls.label: Record it
controls.does: For money out (a bank charge): opens Expenses filled in with the bank's words, the amount, the day and 'paid from the bank'. controls.rules: Shown when a line not in the books is money in.

controls.rules: Shown when a line not in the books is money in.

parts.name: Ticking and keeping
parts.shows: The table of the books' bank lines up to the chosen day: tick box, Date, Journal, What, Money in, Money out. Under it a summary: 'The last statement: {amount}', 'Money in, ticked: {amount} · Money out, ticked: {amount}', 'The lines ticked take the bank to: {amount}', and when a balance is typed either 'It ties with the statement.' (green) or 'The statement says {closing}: {difference} apart.' (red).

controls.rules: After the last statement kept's day, up to today. Default today (or the statement's last line when read).

controls.label: The balance on the statement

controls.rules: A number; may be negative (overdrawn).

title: Journals
summary: Every entry in the books, by number, newest first (sales, bills, payments, counts, cash moved, expenses and journals posted by hand), with a form to post a journal by hand: save it as a draft, publish it, reverse a published one, or discard a draft.

who.can: post, publish, discard drafts, reverse; also post a correction to a control account
who.cannot: edit or delete a published entry (nobody can)

who.can: post, publish, discard drafts, reverse journals not written by a record
who.cannot: post to accounts with a subledger; post a control-account correction

who.can: read the register, search, open entries, see an account's lines
who.cannot: post, publish, discard or reverse

who.can: nothing here
who.cannot: open the screen

get_there: Menu → Accountant → Journals (under More for the owner, a general manager, a branch manager and purchasing). Also: an account name on Chart of Accounts or a figure on Reports opens its lines here; 'Record it' on the bank page opens a filled-in journal.
before: The month of the journal's date must be open (not locked).

parts.name: Heading
parts.shows: 'Journals', 'Every entry in the book, by number, newest first', a badge '{n} draft' when drafts exist, and this month's name with its state ('2026-09 open').

controls.label: Print or save as PDF
controls.does: Prints the register.

parts.name: New Journal
parts.shows: For the owner, a general manager and the accountant. Closed at first: a 'New Journal' button and 'For anything that is not a sale, a receipt, a bill, a payment or an expense. Stock, payables, goods-received and retained earnings are kept by their own records and take no manual journal.' Header note: 'Debits must equal credits before it can be published'. Open: Date, Reverse on, Journal # ('{n} (given on publish)'), Reference #, Currency (IQD), Notes, the lines (Account, Description, Debits, Credits) and the voucher totals 'Total (IQD) {debits} / {credits}' and 'Difference' (green at 0, red otherwise).

controls.label: New Journal
controls.does: Opens the form with two empty lines (opened already when coming from the bank page, with Dr 1020 Bank filled in).

controls.label: Date *
controls.does: The journal's date (noon that day).
controls.rules: Default today. Must be in an open month.

controls.label: Reverse on (optional)
controls.does: A day to reverse it automatically. Shows 'On publishing, a mirror entry dated {date} is posted too, reversing every line below.'
controls.rules: After the journal's date. Hidden for a correction.

controls.label: Journal #
controls.does: Read-only: the number it will likely get; the real number is given only on publish.

controls.label: Reference #
controls.does: Your own reference (an invoice number…); searchable.
controls.rules: Up to 60 letters.

controls.label: Currency
controls.does: Read-only: the café's currency.

controls.label: Correction to a control account (the till's cash, Inventory, payables, goods received, retained earnings) — owner only, with a reason on the audit trail. For repairing history recorded before the controls; see docs/REMEDIATION.md.
controls.does: Switches the form to a control-account correction: the account lists also offer the blocked accounts, 'Reverse on' is hidden, 'Save as draft' is disabled and 'Reason for the correction *' appears.

controls.label: Reason for the correction *
controls.does: What was wrong and how this entry puts it right; goes on the audit trail.
controls.rules: Required for a correction, up to 500 letters.

controls.label: Notes *
controls.does: What the journal is for ('Being …').
controls.rules: Required, up to 500 letters.

controls.label: Account
controls.does: The account of the line ('Select an account').

controls.label: Description
controls.does: A note on the line.
controls.rules: Up to 200 letters.

controls.label: Debits / Credits
controls.does: The line's amount, on one side; typing in one clears the other.
controls.rules: 0 or more; Arabic and Kurdish digits and commas accepted.

controls.does: Removes the line ('Remove line').
controls.rules: Disabled when only two lines are left.

controls.label: + Add line
controls.does: Adds an empty line.

controls.label: Save and publish
controls.does: Saves and publishes at once ('Saving…' while it works); a correction is published this way.
controls.rules: Needs Notes, at least two lines with an account and an amount, debits equal to credits and above 0 (and a reason for a correction). Otherwise disabled; with a difference 'Debits and credits must agree before it can be published.' shows.
controls.after: The journal gets the next number and is in the books: trial balance, reports, P&L, balance sheet. With 'Reverse on', a mirror journal dated that day is posted too. A line on 1020 Bank appears among the bank's open lines. A correction goes on the audit trail as 'Owner's correction posted' with the reason.

controls.label: Save as draft
controls.does: Saves without publishing.
controls.rules: Needs Notes and at least one line; may be unbalanced. Disabled for a correction.
controls.after: Not in the books; listed first in the register as 'draft'; it blocks the month's close until published or discarded.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.does: Empties and closes the form.

controls.label: Back to the bank's statement
controls.does: Shown after publishing a journal opened from the bank page; goes back there, where the line is found and ticked.

parts.name: Journal Register
parts.shows: Up to 200 entries, drafts first, then by number newest first: Date, Journal # (or 'draft'), Reference (where it came from — Sale, Refund, Reversal, Receipt, Bill, Payment, Expense, Stock, Loss, Count, Drawer count, Drawer opened, Cash moved, Manual, Correction, Card settlement, Platform settlement, Year end, Payroll, Advance, Salaries, Transfer sent, Transfer received, Transfer cancelled, Prepaid expense, Delivery correction, Return to a supplier, Supplier's credit, Void, Batch cancelled, Money moved, Dollars exchanged, Dollars counted — and its reference number), Status ('Draft' or 'Published', and 'before controls' for old entries), Notes (with '· reverses #{no}' or '· reversed by #{no}'), Amount (total debits), Posted by. A note under it: a published entry is never edited or deleted, a mistake is reversed, only a draft may be discarded, numbers have no gaps.

controls.label: All
controls.does: Shows every source.

controls.label: Manual and reversals
controls.does: Shows only journals posted by hand and reversals.

controls.label: Find a journal
controls.does: Search by number or by words in the description, the reference or a line's description ('Its number, or words in it').
controls.rules: Up to 60 letters; words need at least 2 letters.

controls.label: Find
controls.does: Runs the search.

controls.label: {journal number}
controls.does: Opens or closes the entry's voucher: each line as Dr or Cr with account and description, 'Being {notes}', and 'Balanced — {amount} both sides' or 'Out by {amount}'.

controls.label: Publish
controls.does: Publishes a draft ('Publish to the books').
controls.rules: Disabled when the draft does not balance ('Does not balance').
controls.after: As 'Save and publish': it gets its number and is in the books.

controls.label: Discard
controls.does: Deletes the draft at once (no question asked).
controls.after: The draft is gone; nothing in the books changes.

controls.label: Reverse
controls.does: Opens 'Reverse journal {no} with a mirror entry dated' with a date and 'Why is it being reversed?'.
controls.rules: Only on published entries not reversed yet that no record stands behind: Manual, Correction, Expense (not a prepaid expense's monthly share), Year end, and old 'before controls' entries. Sales, bills, counts and the like are corrected on their own screens.

controls.label: Date of the reversal
controls.does: The reversal's date.
controls.rules: From the entry's day up to today; default today. A journal that moved the till's or the safe's cash (1000, 1001, 1005, 1006) must be reversed today.

controls.label: Why is it being reversed?
controls.does: The reason.
controls.rules: Required, up to 300 letters.

controls.label: Post reversal
controls.does: Posts the mirror entry ('Reversal: {reason}').
controls.after: A new published journal with every line swapped; the original shows 'reversed by #{no}'. If it touched the till's cash, the drawer's expected cash changes by the same amount. An expense reversed comes off the P&L. Audit trail: 'Journal reversed' with the reason.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.does: Closes the reverse box.

parts.name: Four tiles
